stations.say: Put it on the site today.

stations.title: Shop's server
stations.text: Femi sent a new find this morning.

captions: Wilma wants the vouchers on the server and the shop's August closing on the site today.
Femi sent work to the server this morning, so a push of your main is refused.
You push a branch, commit the closing, pull Femi's find and push again, in four tasks.
The server has your work and Femi's, side by side, and nothing was lost.
Pull first, then push: the server is one history everyone adds to.
